plugins.name: RONE Reverse Reverb
plugins.description: Tempo-synced reverse reverb for risers, vocal swells and seamless transitions - tail lengths from 1/32 to 8 bars, shaped with fades, filters and stereo width
plugins.whats_new: Now named RONE Reverse Reverb in your DAW so every RONE plugin sits together (rescan once; projects load unchanged). Pitch fix: the file is resampled to the session rate, so a 44.1k file no longer plays sharp in a 48k session. Drag-to-export clips are saved to Documents/RONE Plugins/Exports instead of the temp folder. A full user manual ships in the install folder.

plugins.name: RONE Stutter
plugins.description: Tempo-locked stutter engine - beat divisions, sculpted fade curves and stereo movement for instant fills, edits and glitch builds
plugins.whats_new: Now named RONE Stutter in your DAW so every RONE plugin sits together (rescan once; projects load unchanged). Exports and drag-to-export clips are saved to Documents/RONE Plugins/Exports - no more missing samples - and keep the session's sample rate. A full user manual ships in the install folder and opens from the Center.

plugins.name: RONE Stucker
plugins.description: One knob that grabs the loop and rolls it up - the captured slice shrinks tighter and tighter until it screams, then lets go right back into the beat
plugins.whats_new: Now named RONE Stucker in your DAW so every RONE plugin sits together in the list (rescan once; existing projects load unchanged). A full user manual ships in the install folder and opens from the Center.

plugins.name: RONE Flanger
plugins.description: A transition riser flanger - sweep it by hand or engage INFINITE barberpole mode for endless bar-locked rises and falls, with feedback, stereo offset and a rhythmic gate
plugins.whats_new: Now named RONE Flanger in your DAW so every RONE plugin sits together in the list (rescan once; existing projects load unchanged). A full user manual ships in the install folder and opens from the Center.

plugins.name: RONE AFTERSPACE
plugins.description: Creative reverb, delay and atmosphere designer - huge cinematic spaces that stay clean via built-in ducking, a tail de-esser (SILK), auto-gain and tempo-synced echo, all in one plugin
plugins.whats_new: A full user manual now ships in the install folder and opens from the Center's card menu.

plugins.name: RONE Analyzer
plugins.description: Professional measurement suite: 30-band spectrum with reference-track comparison, vectorscope, level meters, EBU R128 loudness and bit statistics
plugins.whats_new: A full user manual now ships in the install folder and opens from the Center's card menu.
